items.item: 3. The ceiling re-plan and the G01 guard: correct and minimal; facts not kept, a question about unknown training, history
items.answer: PARTIAL. The guard is correct, and no path was found where the re-plan acts on facts the record does not keep, travels with an UNREPORTED_TRAINING question or rewrites history. The re-plan is not a sufficient fix for the class it was introduced for (QE-R7C-07).
evidence: G01 guard: in the suite census it fires once (the directed test) and 3 times in the G01 grid (the P1 schedule changes). Every re-decision is ASK UNREPORTED_TRAINING, REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION, with no proposal. The NO_CEILING key is a module-private Symbol, so no caller can set it. The ceiling re-plan's own composition cannot raise UNREPORTED_TRAINING for its own week: overCeiling requires !runGapInForce(ctx), and composeWeeks runs the same unknownRunWindow for fromWeek = w with the same completed runs.

Facts the record does not keep: the return-entry week is excluded (RETURN_ENTRY), return and restart weeks are excluded by mode, and a return report is excluded. The week after a re-entry week (rc-p1, 60 cases) is unchanged from FREEZE-1. In RETURN mode the stored step stays VALID over an unreported re-entry week on both freezes; that is the pre-existing G01 scope (easy running only), not the delta.

History: every proposal goes through immutabilityErrors and validateWeeks in evaluateProgram, and fails closed to UNSUPPORTED. The directed tests assert past() unchanged; SD grid H1 has 0 violations. No probe here changed a past prescription.

Not minimal in effect, and not sufficient: the trigger reads only minutes above the ceiling. (a) Answers with executed gap runs leave the stale projection in force (QE-R7C-07). (b) In the never-reported class with the intake run still in the window, credited doses within the ceiling stay VALID, including a quality session at week 4 (QE-R7C-08, pre-existing). (c) The re-plan re-composes every sport, not only the run doses the handoff names; in the never-reported fixture the strength rows go from FROM_LOG 3x5 to ESTABLISH 2x5, exactly as on the on-time path (rc-p3).
Provenance: after an uncredited re-plan, the week b+1 start records a RUN premise that names the uncredited session as assumed executed (QE-R7C-09, observation).

items.answer: ACCEPT as EXPECTED_SEMANTIC_UPDATE, subject to the SSCTR accepting the ceiling re-plan semantics (as the test comment states)

The reference state names the proposal. On FREEZE-1 the same reviews give ASK with no proposal, and the plain review KEEPs EASY 40 / QUALITY 34 / LONG 60.

A factual re-plan travelling with a question that is not about unknown training is the pre-existing withFactualReplan rule: a question or a refusal is still asked, with the re-plan proposed. The original reading (no proposal at all) is kept where nothing is credited (weeks 0-1 reported as prescribed), so INV-11 ('asked, never applied') is still pinned. The new assertion checks only week 3's barbell rows; rc-p3's whole-plan equality covers the rest.

findings.title: QE-R7C-01 is closed only for known-stop answers: an executed, mixed or adverse answer that an R4 HOLD or a handler clinical route records is still never applied, and the stale projection stays VALID
findings.origin: Introduced by R7-C. The UNREPORTED_TRAINING question leaves a projection stored while training was unknown. gapAnsweredBy still detects an answer only as a transition between the carried record and the same review's reports, so a decision that records the answer without applying it (the last-week SCHEDULE_CHANGE exception, R4; EXERCISE_SUBSTITUTION with pain; a clinical RETURN_AFTER_PAUSE) leaves nothing for a later review to detect. The cycle's ceiling re-plan (aboveFactsCeiling) catches the stale projection only when a stored dose exceeds the facts' single-run ceiling. That holds after a known stop (no completed run: ceiling = entry 15). Executed gap runs lift the ceiling (70-75 here) above every stale dose.

findings.expected: The predecessor's QE-R7C-01 expectation, unchanged: once the canonical facts make the window known, the run doses still ahead follow those facts, whichever decision carried the reports (projection vs fact; deterministic answer processing; no stale dose in race week; evidence preservation). SSCTR-SD-R7C-r2's own grid properties, as the SD grid applies them to direct answers: M2 (mixed evidence never leaves a run longer than the on-time plan's) and E1 (adverse responses change the plan and never lengthen the long run).
findings.actual: The next decision KEEPs the projection stored while the training was unknown, VALID, re-sent or not. This is a race touch in race week, quality in the taper, and LONG 60 where the adverse long runs give LONG 35.
findings.consumerShield: None. The plan is VALID, so C2 (REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION) does not apply. C3's re-send after clearance changes nothing, because the reports are already in the carried record (dedupe).
findings.disclosureImpact: The FREEZE-2 handoff says, under R4, 'Since the correction cycle, the next decision applies it (the ceiling re-plan)', and under R5, 'After a handler clinical route, which records the answer, the next decision after qualified clearance applies it, with or without the re-send'. Both are false for executed, mixed and adverse answers. The SD grid still classifies its 24 R4 HOLD cells and never looks at the decision after them.
findings.smallestFix: As the predecessor proposed for QE-R7C-01: make the answered re-plan state-based, not transition-based, and not ceiling-based. Re-plan from the facts (factualReplan with uncredited) whenever the run doses still ahead were stored while the window was unknown and the canonical facts now make it known, whichever decision recorded the reports. One way: the reference state (or the program) records that an UNREPORTED_TRAINING question stood when the week's run doses were stored, so a later decision whose facts close that window re-plans. Another: compare against the record as the decision that composed the week saw it (a received-at reference). Keep the ceiling re-plan for the never-reported class if the SSCTR accepts it. Add directed tests for R4 and for the clinical carriers x V in {MISS, EXEC, MIXED, ADVERSE} x with and without the re-send; rc-p4 is a ready grid. Policy, catalog and the clinical routes are untouched.
findings.routing: No second correction cycle is permitted: R7-C closes CLOSED_NOT_READY. The fix belongs to the next runtime mission. No product, policy, catalog or clinical decision is needed to judge it.
